overall_assessment: acceptable_at_candidate_stage: The changed tests substantively exercise the approved behavior rather than merely status codes or no-throw paths: real disposable PostgreSQL/BFF, bounded fake-provider counters, served-bundle Playwright, durable-state readback, and negative zero-effect assertions are used across the critical paths. The package discloses mixed test-first chronology rather than misrepresenting it; current corrective regressions have causal evidence where claimed. No test-only product route, silent live fallback, focused/skip bypass, or DI substitution that masks the relevant production boundary is evidenced. Assertions are generally effective and proportionate, including replay, race, fence, rollback, stale UI, current-resource window, and template-eligibility failures. D01-D10 candidate coverage is materially supported. The real-provider/runtime/operator, module-consolidation, canonical diff-guard, and final delivery gates remain intentionally unproven.

findings.title: Delivery-only validation remains pending
findings.rationale: The E64 evidence supports the candidate test surface with real disposable PG/BFF and a served browser bundle, but it explicitly does not prove preserved-runtime migration/activation, actual own-channel approved-template use and reply, canonical full diff-guard execution, module consolidation, or final delivery review. These are not pass-the-test shortcuts in the changed tests, but they prevent a delivery-complete interpretation.
findings.suggested_action: Keep DOD-11 through DOD-13 and the stated runtime/operator, module, diff-guard, and final-review gates open; require their separately bounded evidence before any completion or production-readiness claim.
